knowledgeBlocks.blockName: Step1-从信网贷产品基础信息加工产品参数
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_PRD_ITNET_LOAN_PROD_PARAM_H_01
SELECT PROD_NO AS BUSS_CODE, PROD_NAME AS BUSS_NM, PROD_NO, PROD_NAME,
       CASE WHEN CHAN_CD = '信保贷' OR CHAN_CD = '平安新模式' THEN '0202'
            WHEN TYPE_CD = '联合贷' THEN '0203'
            WHEN TYPE_CD = '助贷' THEN '0204'
            WHEN TYPE_CD = '自营' THEN '0205'
            ELSE TYPE_CD END TYPE_CD,
       CASE WHEN CHAN_CD = '信保贷' OR CHAN_CD = '平安新模式' THEN '信保贷'
            WHEN CHAN_CD = '助贷' THEN '联合助贷'
            ELSE TYPE_CD END TYPE_NM,
       CASE WHEN CHAN_CD = '信保贷' OR CHAN_CD = '平安新模式' THEN '个人信贷部'
            WHEN CHAN_CD = '易鑫' THEN '信用卡部'
            WHEN PROD_NO='4001' THEN '个人信贷部'
            ELSE '互联网贷款部' END BELO_TO_DEPT_NAME,
       '-',
       CASE WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'DZ' THEN '-'
            WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'MY' THEN '0092'
            WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'XJ' THEN '0198'
            ELSE '-' END ASSES_ORG_NO,
       CASE WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'DZ' THEN 'UPEA'
            WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'XJ' THEN 'CFXF'
            WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'MY' THEN 'MYLN'
            WHEN SOURC_SYS = 'XF' THEN 'XFLN'
            ELSE SOURC_SYS END BELO_TO_ORG_NO,
       '0310' AS LOAN_TYPE_CD,
       CASE WHEN PROD_NO IN ('0201','0301','02013000') THEN '13030304' ELSE '-' END SUBJ_NO,
       '13130201', '13130202', '13130203',
       CASE WHEN USAGE_CD = '经营' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END LOAN_USE_TO_CD,
       USAGE_CD AS LOAN_USE_TO_DESCN,
       CASE WHEN GUAR_MODE_CD='保证' THEN '010'
            WHEN GUAR_MODE_CD='信用' THEN '005'
            WHEN GUAR_MODE_CD='抵押' THEN '003'
            ELSE GUAR_MODE_CD END GUAR_MODE_CD,
       GUAR_MODE_CD AS GUAR_MODE_DESCN,
       ITNET_LOAN_FLAG
  FROM FDM.F_PD_CFXF_PROD_BASE_INF
 WHERE START_DT <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND END_DT > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'

INSERT INTO CDM.C_PRD_ITNET_LOAN_PROD_PARAM_H_01
SELECT productno AS BUSS_CODE, productname AS BUSS_NM, productno AS PROD_NO, productname AS PROD_NAME,
       CASE WHEN channel IN ('信保贷','平安新模式') THEN '0202'
            WHEN pd_blg = '联合贷' THEN '0203'
            WHEN pd_blg = '助贷' THEN '0204'
            WHEN pd_blg = '自营' THEN '0205' ELSE pd_blg END TYPE_CD,
       CASE WHEN channel IN ('信保贷','平安新模式') THEN '信保贷'
            WHEN channel = '助贷' THEN '联合助贷' ELSE pd_blg END TYPE_NM,
       CASE WHEN channel IN ('信保贷','平安新模式') THEN '个人信贷部'
            WHEN channel = '易鑫' THEN '信用卡部'
            WHEN productno='4001' THEN '个人信贷部'
            ELSE '互联网贷款部' END BELO_TO_DEPT_NAME,
       '-',
       CASE WHEN chnl_sys='DZ' THEN '-' WHEN chnl_sys='MY' THEN '0092' WHEN chnl_sys='XJ' THEN '0198' ELSE '-' END ASSES_ORG_NO,
       CASE WHEN chnl_sys='DZ' THEN 'UPEA' WHEN chnl_sys='XJ' THEN 'CFXF' WHEN chnl_sys='MY' THEN 'MYLN' WHEN chnl_sys='XF' THEN 'XFLN' ELSE chnl_sys END BELO_TO_ORG_NO,
       '0310' AS LOAN_TYPE_CD,
       CASE WHEN productno IN ('0201','0301','02013000') THEN '13030304' ELSE '-' END SUBJ_NO,
       '13130201', '13130202', '13130203',
       CASE WHEN loanused='经营' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END LOAN_USE_TO_CD,
       loanused AS LOAN_USE_TO_DESCN,
       CASE WHEN zassure_type='保证' THEN '010' WHEN zassure_type='信用' THEN '005' WHEN zassure_type='抵押' THEN '003' ELSE zassure_type END GUAR_MODE_CD,
       zassure_type AS GUAR_MODE_DESCN,
       wd_flag AS ITNET_LOAN_FLAG
  FROM ODM.O_CFXF_PROD_CONFIG_ALL
